external_entities.name: developers
external_entities.description: People who push branches to the self-hosted git server and can manually start a rebuild of main on the build runner.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Developers push their branches to our self-hosted git server

external_entities.name: public package registry
external_entities.description: Public package registry on the internet used during dependency resolution.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Dependency resolution reaches out to the public package registry on the internet

processes.name: build runner
processes.description: Picks up merges, fetches source, resolves the dependency lockfile, produces container images, pushes images to the image registry, calls the deploy controller, and can be used by developers to start manual rebuilds.
processes.source_excerpt: The build runner picks the merge up, fetches the source, resolves the dependency lockfile and produces a container image.
processes.notes: The runner uses a shared build token to call the deploy controller. It does not verify signatures on downloads.

processes.name: deploy controller
processes.description: Controller that receives the current image release request and answers store servers about the current release.
processes.source_excerpt: The deploy controller runs on the corporate network and holds one record: which image sha the estate should be on.

processes.name: store server
processes.description: A small server in each store's back office running the till software as a container. It polls the deploy controller, pulls a changed image, and restarts the container.
processes.source_excerpt: Each store has a small server in the back office running the till software as a container.
processes.notes: The description covers approximately 1,200 store servers.

processes.name: till software
processes.description: Software running as a container on each store server.
processes.source_excerpt: running the till software as a container

data_stores.name: git server
data_stores.description: Self-hosted git server holding developer branches and the main branch used to start builds.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Developers push their branches to our self-hosted git server
data_stores.notes: Nobody has documented whether the git server encrypts what it stores.

data_stores.name: image registry
data_stores.description: Registry in the build environment holding finished container images tagged with commit shas.
data_stores.source_excerpt: It pushes the finished image to our image registry, which is also in the build environment.
data_stores.notes: Nobody has documented whether the image registry encrypts what it stores. The registry allows the pull; nobody has written down what a store server presents to it.

data_stores.name: release record
data_stores.description: The record of which image sha the estate should be on, held by the deploy controller.
data_stores.source_excerpt: holds one record: which image sha the estate should be on

data_flows.name: push branches
data_flows.description: Developers push branches to the git server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Developers push their branches to our self-hosted git server

data_flows.name: start build
data_flows.description: A merge to main starts a build on the build runner.
data_flows.source_excerpt: A merge to `main` is what starts a build.

data_flows.name: fetch source
data_flows.description: The build runner fetches source from the git server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The build runner picks the merge up, fetches the source

data_flows.name: resolve dependencies
data_flows.description: The build runner reaches out to the public package registry while resolving dependencies.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Dependency resolution reaches out to the public package registry on the internet
data_flows.notes: The runner does not verify signatures on what it downloads.

data_flows.name: push image
data_flows.description: The build runner pushes the finished container image to the image registry.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It pushes the finished image to our image registry
data_flows.notes: Images are tagged with the commit sha.
data_flows.data_description: finished container image tagged with the commit sha

data_flows.name: make release
data_flows.description: The build runner asks the deploy controller to make an image the current release.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the runner calls the deploy controller and asks it to make that image the current release
data_flows.notes: The token used is a shared build token, the same for every pipeline, and has not been rotated since the pipeline was set up.
data_flows.data_description: current image release request containing an image sha

data_flows.name: update release
data_flows.description: The deploy controller updates the record of the image sha the estate should be on.
data_flows.source_excerpt: holds one record: which image sha the estate should be on

data_flows.name: ask release
data_flows.description: Each store server asks the deploy controller what the current release is once a minute.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every store server asks the deploy controller once a minute what the current release is
data_flows.notes: Nobody has written down what a store server presents to the controller.

data_flows.name: read release
data_flows.description: The deploy controller reads the current release record when answering release queries.
data_flows.source_excerpt: holds one record: which image sha the estate should be on

data_flows.name: pull image
data_flows.description: A store server pulls the current image from the image registry when its running image differs from the release.
data_flows.source_excerpt: if it differs from what it is running it pulls that image from the registry
data_flows.notes: The registry allows the pull; nobody has written down what a store server presents to it.

data_flows.name: kick off rebuild
data_flows.description: A developer can log in to the build runner and manually start a rebuild of main.
data_flows.source_excerpt: any developer can log in to the build runner and kick off a rebuild of `main` by hand
data_flows.notes: This path does not require a merge and is not reviewed.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: Corporate network containing the self-hosted git server and deploy controller.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: which sits on the corporate network

trust_boundaries.name: build environment
trust_boundaries.description: Separate build environment containing the build runner and image registry.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The runner lives in its own build environment, separate from the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: store estate
trust_boundaries.description: The estate of approximately 1,200 stores containing the store servers.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The image registry is reachable from the store estate over the WAN.

trust_boundaries.name: retail WAN
trust_boundaries.description: WAN used for traffic between the stores and the corporate network.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Traffic between the stores and the corporate network goes over the retail WAN.
